hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query:

sum(target1) as target1 ,sum(result1) as result1 ,sum(target2) as target2 ,sum(result2) as result2 ,sum(target3) as target3 ,sum(result3) as result3  from chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s on h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} where (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{MINISTRY_CODE}}) and (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) and (h.chw_code={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{DISTRICT_CODE}})  and  (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{DISTRICT_CODE}}) and h.hdc_regist=1 and h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) and h.hoscode in ( select hoscode from  ccmihosp where byear = {{YEAR}} AND ( splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}  or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) )  GROUP BY h.hoscode,concat(h.hoscode  order by h.hoscode

moo.label: หมู่
moo.query:
select s.areacode as a_code,concat("ต.",c.tambonname," ",IF(LENGTH(s.areacode)=7,SUBSTR(s.areacode,-1), IF(LENGTH(s.areacode)=8,SUBSTR(s.areacode,-2),"ไม่ระบุ"))) as a_name,  
sum(target1) as target1 ,sum(result1) as result1 ,sum(target2) as target2 ,sum(result2) as result2 ,sum(target3) as target3 ,sum(result3) as result3  from ctambon c INNER JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s on SUBSTR(s.areacode,1,6) = c.tamboncodefull AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} left join chospital_regis as h on h.hoscode = s.hospcode where (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{MINISTRY_CODE}}) and (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) and (h.chw_code={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})  and  (c.tamboncodefull={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})  and h.hoscode in ( select hoscode from  ccmihosp where byear = {{YEAR}} AND ( splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}  or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) )   GROUP BY s.areacode,concat("ต."  order by a_name
